# jwe — JSON Web Encryption

[All groups](README.md)

## jwe decrypt

Decrypt a compact JWE with every registered algorithm: RSA-OAEP(-256/384/512), RSA1_5, ECDH-ES (+A128/192/256KW, P-256/384/521 and X25519), AES key wrap, AES-GCM key wrap, PBES2 and dir; content A128/192/256GCM and A128CBC-HS256/A192CBC-HS384/A256CBC-HS512; zip=DEF. Shows the header, the payload or nested JWT, and flags weak choices.

MCP tool: `jwe_decrypt`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--token` | string | The compact JWE (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--key` | string | Decryption key: PEM private key, or a private or oct JWK. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--password` | string | Password for PBES2 (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## jwe encrypt

Encrypt a payload or JSON claims into a compact JWE for a recipient key (public PEM/JWK, or an oct JWK for dir and AES key wrap, or a password for PBES2). For producing test tokens.

MCP tool: `jwe_encrypt`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--alg` | string | Key management: RSA-OAEP-256, RSA-OAEP, ECDH-ES, ECDH-ES+A128KW, ECDH-ES+A256KW, A128KW, A256KW, dir, PBES2-HS256+A128KW…. Default `RSA-OAEP-256`. |
| `--enc` | string | Content encryption. Default `A256GCM`. One of `A128GCM`, `A192GCM`, `A256GCM`, `A128CBC-HS256`, `A192CBC-HS384`, `A256CBC-HS512`. |
| `--key` | string | Recipient key: public PEM or certificate, a public JWK, or an oct JWK. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--password` | string | Password for PBES2. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--payload` | string | Plaintext to encrypt (or use claims). CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--claims` | json | JSON claims to encrypt. |
| `--iat-now` | bool | Add iat to claims when missing. Default `true`. |
| `--kid` | string | kid header. |
| `--cty` | string | cty header, e.g. JWT for a nested token. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
